basics.name: Samuel Hernandez
basics.label: Computer Engineering Student
basics.summary: Fourth-year Computer Engineering student at UC San Diego with experience in academic tutoring and hardware research.

work.name: UC San Diego CSE Department
work.summary: CSE Tutor for courses CSE 15L, CSE 8A, and CSE 29. Responsibilities included serving as Head Tutor for CSE 29 and Lead Tutor for CSE 8A.
highlights: Led an additional 2-hour lab section and provided hands-on support for student groups.
Refined grading scripts and improved automation for evaluating programming assignments and labs.
Managed grading allocation, held supplemental office hours, and maintained the course website.
Collaborated with TAs to finalize discussion slides and weekly instructional materials.
Guided 4 groups of 8-10 students in weekly 2-hour labs for various courses.
Contributed to the development of new teaching material and lab content.
Graded 120+ assignments with detailed feedback and answered over 150+ student questions online.

work.name: ESB.AI Lab
highlights: Optimized hardware for remote data collection systems, including soldering, camera testing, and power consumption management.
Implemented bash scripting for automated time lapse photography and video recording, enhancing efficiency in data acquisition.
Contributed in the labeling of relevant data collected that are crucial for the training of object detection models.

Assisted in presenting project results and secured a $50,000 CA CARES Grant from UC San Diego's OIC for advancing climate adaptation technologies, highlighting the system's effectiveness in invasive species detection.

volunteer.summary: Lead organizer for the New York City branch of the People's Climate March, the largest climate march in history.
highlights: Awarded 'Climate Hero' award by Greenpeace for my efforts organizing the march.
Men of the year 2014 by Time magazine
